overview.purpose_zh: 把四个地区八个季度的销售额并排放在一起，既比较同一季度里谁高谁低，也看每个地区两年里的变化。
works_zh: 同一季度内四个地区的高低比较
需要读出具体数字和差距的场合
看两年里排名有没有变化
uses_zh: 连锁门店的季度经营回顾
年度预算会上的区域盘点

understanding.read_zh: 先看横轴上同一个季度里的四根柱子，最高的那根就是当季销售额最大的地区；再沿着同一种颜色从一个季度看到下一个季度，跟住这个地区的走势。柱子之间的长度差，就是当季销售额的差距。需要精确读出季度差距时，分组柱比折线更直接：柱子把具体数值并排摆出来，折线则把重点放在走势上。

elements.note_zh: 从 2024-Q1 到 2025-Q4 共八个季度，每个刻度是一组柱子。
销售额，单位是千美元；刻度从零开始，柱子的长度可以按比例直接比较。
四种颜色分别对应东部、南部、北部和西部四个地区。
同一季度的四根柱子并排站立，没有堆叠，方便直接比长短。

look_for_zh: 同一季度里第一名和第二名差多少
八个季度里有没有地区被反超
有没有哪个季度出现回落

observations.en: East led every quarter and finished at 690 in 2025-Q4, more than twice North's 334.
observations.zh: 东部每个季度都领先，2025 年四季度收在 690，是北部 334 的两倍多。

observations.en: West more than doubled, from 190 in 2024-Q1 to 415 in 2025-Q4, and climbed from last place to third.
observations.zh: 西部从 2024 年一季度的 190 增长到 2025 年四季度的 415，翻了一倍多，排名从最后升到第三。

observations.en: South held second place in every quarter, rising from 310 to 452.
observations.zh: 南部每个季度都守在第二，销售额从 310 升到 452。

observations.en: North was the only region to dip, slipping from 260 to 255 in 2024-Q2, and it ended last at 334.
observations.zh: 北部是唯一出现回落的地区，2024 年二季度从 260 滑到 255，最后以 334 排在末位。

observations.en: The four regions together sold 1891 in 2025-Q4, up from 1180 in 2024-Q1.
observations.zh: 四个地区 2025 年四季度合计做到 1891，高于 2024 年一季度的 1180。

describe.en: In 2025-Q4, East, South, West and North recorded 690, 452, 415 and 334 respectively.
describe.zh: 2025 年四季度，东部、南部、西部和北部分别为 690、452、415 和 334。
describe.pattern: A, B, C and D + verb + X, Y, Z and W + respectively
alternatives: East, South, West and North posted 690, 452, 415 and 334 in that order.
The four regions finished at 690, 452, 415 and 334 respectively.
describe.note_zh: respectively 要求两边顺序一一对应，地区顺序和数字顺序不能错位。

describe.en: East's 690 was higher than South's 452 in 2025-Q4.
describe.zh: 2025 年四季度，东部的 690 高于南部的 452。
alternatives: East finished at 690, higher than South at 452.
East was ahead of South in 2025-Q4, 690 against 452.
describe.note_zh: 两个数并排放，听的人一眼就知道谁高；差距大时可以加 much，差距小就加 slightly。

describe.en: East increased from 420 in 2024-Q1 to 690 in 2025-Q4.
describe.zh: 东部从 2024 年一季度的 420 增长到 2025 年四季度的 690。
describe.pattern: increase from + starting value + to + ending value
alternatives: East sales rose from 420 to 690 over the two years.
East grew from 420 in 2024-Q1 to 690 in 2025-Q4.
describe.note_zh: from ... to ... 同时给起点和终点，信息最完整；既然两端都给了，就不需要再补 by。

describe.en: East rose steadily in all eight quarters, from 420 to 690.
describe.zh: 东部八个季度里稳步上升，从 420 升到 690。
alternatives: There was a steady rise in East sales, from 420 to 690.
describe.note_zh: steadily 强调每个季度都在涨、节奏均匀；只说涨得慢用 gradually。

describe.en: East rose quarter on quarter from 632 in 2025-Q3 to 690 in 2025-Q4.
describe.zh: 东部环比上升，从 2025 年三季度的 632 升到四季度的 690。
alternatives: East's quarter-on-quarter gain took it from 632 to 690.
East was up from 632 to 690 compared with the previous quarter.
describe.note_zh: 环比比的是相邻两个季度；和去年同一季度比则用 year on year，两者不要混。

describe.en: Every region peaked in 2025-Q4, with East peaking at 690.
describe.zh: 每个地区都在 2025 年四季度达到最高，东部峰值为 690。
describe.pattern: peak at + value / peak in + period
alternatives: East peaked at 690 in the final quarter of 2025.
All four regions reached their highest quarter at the end of 2025.
describe.note_zh: peak at 后面跟数值，peak in 后面跟时间段；峰值最高不等于涨得最快。

academic.en: The bar chart compares quarterly sales across four regions of a coffee chain from 2024-Q1 to 2025-Q4. East recorded the highest figure in every quarter, with sales rising from 420 to 690. South was placed second throughout, climbing from 310 to 452. The fastest growth was recorded by West, from 190 to 415, and North was overtaken in the process. North was the only region where a quarterly decline was observed, slipping from 260 to 255 in 2024-Q2, and it finished lowest at 334. Total sales rose from 1180 in 2024-Q1 to 1891 in 2025-Q4.
academic.zh: 这张柱状图比较一家连锁咖啡公司四个地区从 2024 年一季度到 2025 年四季度的季度销售额。东部每个季度都录得最高值，销售额从 420 升到 690。南部始终排在第二，从 310 升到 452。增长最快的是西部，从 190 升到 415，并在过程中超过了北部。北部是唯一出现季度回落的地区，2024 年二季度从 260 滑到 255，最后以 334 垫底。合计销售额从 2024 年一季度的 1180 升到 2025 年四季度的 1891。

business.en: East is our steady anchor: 690 in the final quarter of 2025, more than twice North's 334. West is the growth story for our team, up from 190 to 415 in two years and now clearly ahead of North. South keeps a solid second place at 452. North is the one region that slipped, with a small dip in 2024-Q2 and a last-place finish at 334. We should give West more floor space and staff, and we should schedule a closer review of North next quarter.
business.zh: 东部是我们稳定的主力：2025 年四季度做到 690，是北部 334 的两倍多。西部是我们团队的增长故事，两年里从 190 升到 415，现在已经明显领先北部。南部稳居第二，为 452。北部是唯一下滑的地区，2024 年二季度小幅回落，最后以 334 垫底。我们应给西部更多门店面积和人手，并在下个季度专门复盘北部。

simple.en: East sells the most in every quarter and ends at 690, more than twice North's 334. West grows the fastest. It goes from 190 to 415, more than double, and passes North on the way. South stays in second place at 452. North slips a little in 2024-Q2, from 260 to 255, and ends last at 334. East never loses the lead.
simple.zh: 东部每个季度卖得最多，最后收在 690，是北部 334 的两倍多。西部增长最快，从 190 升到 415，翻了一倍多，路上超过了北部。南部稳居第二，为 452。北部在 2024 年二季度小幅回落，从 260 降到 255，最后以 334 排末位。东部从来没有丢掉第一。

language_notes.body_zh: 两个对象相比用 higher than，把两个数并排放；某个对象在整个组里排第一，用 the highest。前者回答谁比谁高，后者回答谁最高。
examples: East had the highest sales in every quarter, reaching 690 in 2025-Q4.

language_notes.body_zh: by 后面是变化量，to 后面是最后到达的水平。东部从 420 到 690，增加的是 270；写成 rose to 270 就变成只涨到 270，和图上的 690 对不上。
examples: East rose by 270 over the period.

language_notes.title_en: bar length needs a zero baseline
language_notes.body_zh: 柱子的长度只有在纵轴从零开始时才能按比例比较。这张图的纵轴从零开始，所以 690 的柱子比 334 的柱子长一倍多；如果纵轴从中间开始，长短就不代表倍数了。
examples: East's 690 bar is more than twice as long as North's 334 bar.
With a zero baseline, bar length matches the value.
